pattern: \[Win32App\]\[EspManager\] In EspPhase: \w+\. App {GUID} has been registered.*?App name: (?<name>.*?)$
description: Captures the ESP tracked-app registration line ('App <guid> has been registered[ for user <id>]. App name: <name>', EspManager.cs) as an app-name source. Primary replacement for the retired IME-UPDATE-NAME-1/2/3 whose emitters were removed with IME's old V1/V2 processing pipeline; also documents exactly which apps IME registered for ESP tracking. Category 'always' so names resolve even before the first ApplicationPoller EspPhase line is seen.
